Hello! I would be happy to help you with your inquiry. Regarding your request for park opening hours, our parks in the Güneştepe neighborhood are generally open to the public from 07:00 to 23:00 daily. For specific information on a particular park or any seasonal changes, you can check the "Parks and Gardens" section on the official Yeşilvadi Municipality website or call our 153 solution center.

Regarding your request for internal ticket data, I am unable to provide access to private citizen information or internal system logs, as I must prioritize data privacy and security protocols. I can only assist with individual service inquiries or reporting new issues. Please let me know if you need further assistance with municipal services!
